entityDescription:
DI Industrial is a Czech-based engineering and manufacturing company specializing in the production of high-precision components, sub-assemblies, and complete systems for demanding high-tech industries. Founded in 1994, the company builds on a strong legacy of advanced engineering and precision manufacturing. 
The core expertise of DI Industrial lies in delivering complex, customer-specific solutions, particularly for applications in electron microscopy, vacuum technology, and cryogenics. 
The company provides a comprehensive “one-stop-shop” capability covering the full production cycle:
High-precision CNC and conventional machining (turning, milling, grinding) 
Advanced welding and brazing, including electron beam welding and vacuum brazing 
Surface treatments (anodizing, plating, special coatings) 
Clean-room assembly of mechanical and electromechanical systems 
Testing and metrology, including 3D measurement and helium leak testing for vacuum-tight components 
Heat treatment, laser marking, and ultrasonic cleaning 
DI Industrial is particularly strong in manufacturing components that require:
ultra-high precision 
excellent surface quality 
vacuum compatibility and cleanliness 
The company operates under certified quality systems, including ISO 9001 and EN 9100 (aerospace standard), ensuring reliability for critical applications. 
With a highly skilled workforce and integrated technologies under one roof, DI Industrial acts not only as a manufacturer but also as an engineering partner, supporting customers with design optimization and technological solutions to improve performance, cost-efficiency, and lead times

entityName: Max-Delbrück-Centrum für Molekulare Medizin in der Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft
entityDescription:
The Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association aims to transform tomorrow’s medicine through our discoveries of today. At locations in Berlin-Buch, Berlin-Mitte, Heidelberg and Mannheim, our researchers harness interdisciplinary collaboration to decipher the complexities of disease at the systems level – from molecules and cells to organs and the entire organism. Through academic, clinical, and industry partnerships, as well as global networks, we strive to translate biological discoveries into applications that enable the early detection of deviations from health, personalize treatment, and ultimately prevent disease. First founded in 1992, the Max Delbrück Center today inspires and nurtures a diverse talent pool of 1,800 people from over 70 countries. We are 90 percent funded by the German federal government and 10 percent by the state of Berlin.
The MDC was established by law (the MDC Act: https://gesetze.berlin.de/bsbe/document/jlr-MDCGBE2023rahmen).

entityDescription:
Finova Motors S.L. is a Madrid-registered, innovative startup specializing in the design and manufacture of hubless brushless DC (BLDC) outer-rotor electric motors and space-grade attitude-control actuators.
Founded in November 2023 by Dinesh Babu (PhD, Aerospace Engineering) and Pedro Miranda (MBA), the company develops proprietary hubless motor technology across two primary market segments: electric mobility and space systems. In the electric mobility segment, Finova designs and supplies 10-inch and 12-inch hubless BLDC outer-rotor motors for electric scooters and mopeds, with active customers in Spain and international markets. In the space segment, Finova is developing the Hubless Motor-based Control Moment Gyroscope (HM-CMG) and the Hubless Motor-based Reaction Wheel (HM-RW) as compact, high-torque-to-mass attitude-control actuators for small satellites in the 30 to 3,000 kg category.
The HM-CMG integrates a proprietary hubless outer-rotor BLDC spin motor directly with the flywheel, co-axially housing the nutation motor, hollow-through encoder, and hollow slip ring within the central bore of the spin motor assembly. This architecture eliminates the central shaft present in all conventional CMG designs, delivering up to 50% reduction in volume and mass for equivalent angular momentum output, with a scalable design that adjusts axial flywheel width without modifying the overall volumetric envelope.

Mason AI Ltd is an AI architecture and innovation company focused on using frontier AI models to support early-stage scientific, engineering and health-technology concept development. The company specialises in AI-assisted research workflows, systems design, technical problem framing, evidence mapping, prototype planning and expert-facing concept generation.

Our work applies AI as a structured reasoning and design tool: identifying hard technical problems, generating candidate solution architectures, stress-testing assumptions, translating concepts into measurable research questions, and preparing ideas for laboratory, academic or industrial validation. Areas of interest include advanced materials, space technology, biomedical innovation, drug-discovery ideation, AI agents, knowledge systems and production-ready AI workflows.

Mason AI Ltd does not present AI-generated concepts as validated science or finished products. Its role is to accelerate the journey from novel idea to testable research programme by combining AI-assisted inference with clear assumptions, measurable milestones, and expert review.

entityDescription:
Snowpack is a French start-up specializing in cybersecurity, a spin-off from CEA, created in 2021. It was awarded the I-lab 2022 prize, supported by the Cyber Acceleration Strategy, DeepNum20, and won the Grand Prix of the Startup Forum InCyber 2024.
Snowpack develops the VIPN (Virtual & Invisible Private Network) technology – highly innovative and patented – which makes users, data, information system components, and web services exposed on the Internet invisible, eliminating any need for trust in the infrastructure.
Snowpack VIPN thus protects against numerous network attacks, such as surveillance and interception of communications, external scanning of the information system, and exploitation of vulnerabilities in components or services exposed on the Internet. It significantly reduces the external attack surface of organizations by making it invisible and effectively acts as a layer of independence between the infrastructure and the data.
Our technology offers unique properties in terms of cybersecurity and eliminates any need for trust in the Internet infrastructure (i.e., hardware, software, encryption layers, and even Snowpack…).

A Space Systems Innovation Platform (SSIP) is a Swiss-based non-profit association and execution platform dedicated to accelerating the translation of space technologies into industrial, scientific and commercial applications. Headquartered at TECHNOPARK Luzern, SSIP acts as a neutral orchestration layer connecting industry, academia, startups, investors and public institutions across the space ecosystem.
SSIP focuses on the development and commercialization of next-generation space-enabled capabilities, including orbital infrastructure, microgravity research and manufacturing, advanced materials, AI, digital twins, biotechnology and life sciences applications in space. Through strategic partnerships with leading institutions such as Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU) and BIOTESC, SSIP supports the creation of a strong Swiss and international innovation ecosystem capable of transforming scientific excellence into scalable industrial outcomes.
The organization actively develops high-level international collaborations, executive summits, industrial partnerships and startup support initiatives designed to position Switzerland as a leading hub for space-enabled innovation and commercialization. SSIP’s mission is not only to build ecosystems, but to enable execution through structured collaboration, technology translation and long-term industrial development.

entityName: RWTH AACHEN UNIVERSITY - Welding and Joining Institute - ISF
entityDescription:
For more than 70 years the Welding and Joining Institute, ISF, of RWTH Aachen University has been doing research work about modern welding and joining technologies. The work of the ISF comprises almost all industrially relevant, non-detachable joining methods. Those methods include the arc joining methods with their modern process variations, the entire spectrum of the electron and laser beam welding methods, resistance and friction welding processes and also adhesive bonding. In connection, also work about the processing of modern materials with welding methods, about automation and mechanisation, process simulation and also about occupational safety and environmental protection is carried out.
Besides fundamental process analyses which are carried out within the scope of the above-mentioned fields, main emphasis is put on the application-oriented implementation of the gained results into advancement and further development of joining technologies for innovative material and structural design. Within the scope of our scientific work, great importance is placed on the direct industrial cooperation, reaching from smaller projects up to long-term development cooperation.

entityName: UNIV FEDERICO II - Department of Industrial Engineering
entityDescription:
The Department of Industrial Engineering (DII) of the University of Naples Federico II was established on January 1, 2013, inheriting the scientific and educational legacy of five historic departments: Energetics, Applied Thermofluid Dynamics and Environmental Conditioning (DETEC), Aerospace Engineering (DIAS), Management and Industrial Engineering (DIEG), Naval Engineering (DIN), and Mechanical and Energetics Engineering (DiME). Today, the DII is recognized as a center of excellence at both national and international levels, active in the fields of education, scientific research, technology transfer, and the third mission initiatives. The DII operates with a strong multidisciplinary approach and a clear focus on contemporary challenges, such as energy transition and sustainable mobility, which are also central themes in the “Department of Excellence 2023–2027” project.

Consistent with its scientific and educational mission, the DII pursues its strategy along the following key directions: Training highly qualified professionals in the fields of Industrial Engineering, with strong integration into the job market; Promoting and advancing scientific research and its international reach; Supporting technology transfer and innovation, including through the creation of spin-offs; Strengthening partnerships with national and international industrial sectors; • Promoting the internationalization of education and research; Reinforcing inclusion, gender equality, and active student engagement.
The Department’s research activities cover numerous areas, reflecting the breadth and multidisciplinarity of its expertise. The main research outcomes developed within the DII in the fields of aerospace, naval, energy, statistics, mechanical, and management engineering have been collected in the book “A Decade of Research Activities at the Department of Industrial Engineering Unina-dii: From Five Existing Departments to the Excellence in Research”, published by Springer Nature, celebrating the first 10 years of the DII.

entityDescription:
The Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, a member of the Université du Québec network, was created on March 19, 1969 with the integration of the Centre d'études universitaires de Trois-Rivières and the École normale d'état Maurice-L.-Duplessis. The founding rector of the UQTR was Gilles Boulet, a leading figure in regional development.

Located on a campus of almost 59 hectares, and initially housed in buildings that had belonged to the Séminaire Saint-Antoine, run by the Franciscans, the UQTR developed in the heart of the modern part of the city of Trois-Rivières. The physical environment it occupies offers an interesting feature with its rugged topography, the result of a morphological history dating back some 10,000 years.

In 1973, the first educational building to be erected under the aegis of the Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières saw the light of day. This was the Ringuet Pavilion. The construction of new buildings continued over the years, in step with the growth of the clientele and the emergence of new needs.

Today, the UQTR campus comprises more than fifteen buildings, welcoming nearly 14,500 students every year, more than half of whom come from other regions of Quebec. The UQTR also has a campus in Drummondville, as well as eight off-campus university centers.

The Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières has a distinct personality. Accessible and lively, it opens its doors to a world of knowledge and challenges. Its medium-sized size, deep roots in the community and openness to the world make UQTR a great place to study. It offers 289 training programs at all three levels of study and, since its creation, has awarded over 98,000 diplomas to nearly 79,000 graduates.

entityDescription:
At Embed Rover Sp z o.o., our vision is simple to Make IT Simple. We help companies work smarter by offering a EMBRA - a pre-configured, scalable platform based on affordable hardware like Raspberry Pi and LabJack DAQ. Instead of repeatedly building support environments from scratch, businesses can now plug in our solution and start working on developing their products, accelerating development cycles and cutting costs.

During our years as an engineers, we noticed a recurring inefficiency: companies spend too much time setting up environments for development, testing, and simulation. While necessary, these tasks divert attention from the core objective — creating better products. This realization sparked the idea for EMBRA: a platform to automate and optimize these activities, allowing companies to focus on innovation.

Our goal is to provide products and services that support and simplify operations related to spacecraft or instrument simulations, such as so-called flat-sats. Potential users include all companies in the space sector that utilize software elements in their systems, primarily spacecraft/satellite integrators and subsystem/instrument providers.

CloudZen Innovations is a Europe-based data engineering and software automation firm headquartered in Nuremberg, Bavaria, Germany. Established in 2024, the company specializes in designing customized digital solutions for businesses globally.
The firm operates as a one-stop engineering provider delivering enterprise-grade expertise across cloud migration, automation, security, and compliance. Its core competencies include data engineering, data mesh solutions, multi-cloud automation, DevSecOps implementation, data lake infrastructure, advanced data analytics, and machine learning model deployments.
With a team of over 60 professionals comprising data engineers, full-stack developers, designers, and AI and MLOps specialists, CloudZen has successfully delivered more than 50 tailored digital solutions across diverse industry sectors. The company emphasizes collaboration and pioneering research and development to create next-generation applications suited to evolving technological landscapes.
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Offerings:
CloudZen Innovations brings extensive multi-year expertise within the Siemens Teamcenter PLM ecosystem, with core team members possessing 15-18+ years of specialized experience. The company delivers comprehensive PLM solutions across multiple domains:
Simulation Data Management: Teamcenter simulation data management and Teamcenter SMW for managing engineering simulation assets.
CAD Data Management: Full integration and support for major CAD platforms including Siemens NX, Siemens Solid Edge, SolidWorks, and Catia, enabling seamless design data management across diverse engineering environments.
Application Lifecycle Management: Implementation of Siemens Polarion for requirements management, test management, and complete application lifecycle orchestration.
Production Solutions: Teamcenter Easyplan for production planning, Teamcenter-SAP integration capabilities, and Siemens Opcenter for manufacturing operations management.
Service Data Management: Teamcenter Service Lifecycle Management and Capital Asset Lifecycle Management for post-production service operations and asset management.
Analytics and Low-Code Platforms: Siemens MindSphere IoT platform integration and Siemens Mendix low-code application development for digital transformation initiatives.
The company has successfully implemented enterprise-scale PLM projects across the European region, delivering solutions including engineering change management, BOM/BOP management under change control, AR/VR-enabled electronic work instructions, PLM-ERP integration, configuration management, data migration, and DevOps deployment for PLM environments. CloudZen's certified PLM-Cloud-Data practitioners provide both offshore implementation capabilities and onshore workshop facilitation to support global client needs.
SAP Solutions:
CloudZen Innovations provides SAP expertise through its leadership team's deep knowledge in SAP ERP integration, particularly in Material Management and procurement domains. The company specializes in Teamcenter-SAP integration using T4S (Teamcenter for SAP) and T4EA (Teamcenter for Enterprise Applications), enabling bidirectional BOM synchronization between PLM and ERP systems. This includes configuration of multiple SAP version connections, data exchange automation, and seamless integration between product development and enterprise resource planning environments.

CAD Data Management: Full integration and support for major CAD platforms including Siemens NX, Siemens Solid Edge, SolidWorks, and Catia, enabling seamless design data management across diverse engineering environments.
Application Lifecycle Management: Implementation of Siemens Polarion for requirements management, test management, and complete application lifecycle orchestration.
Production Solutions: Teamcenter Easyplan for production planning, Teamcenter-SAP integration capabilities, and Siemens Opcenter for manufacturing operations management.
Service Data Management: Teamcenter Service Lifecycle Management and Capital Asset Lifecycle Management for post-production service operations and asset management.
Analytics and Low-Code Platforms: Siemens MindSphere IoT platform integration and Siemens Mendix low-code application development for digital transformation initiatives.
The company has successfully implemented enterprise-scale PLM projects across the European region, delivering solutions including engineering change management, BOM/BOP management under change control, AR/VR-enabled electronic work instructions, PLM-ERP integration, configuration management, data migration, and DevOps deployment for PLM environments. CloudZen's certified PLM-Cloud-Data practitioners provide both offshore implementation capabilities and onshore workshop facilitation to support global client needs.
SAP Solutions:
CloudZen Innovations provides SAP expertise through its leadership team's deep knowledge in SAP ERP integration, particularly in Material Management and procurement domains. The company specializes in Teamcenter-SAP integration using T4S (Teamcenter for SAP) and T4EA (Teamcenter for Enterprise Applications), enabling bidirectional BOM synchronization between PLM and ERP systems. This includes configuration of multiple SAP version connections, data exchange automation, and seamless integration between product development and enterprise resource planning environments.

Artec 3D is a global leader in AI 3D reconstruction and image processing, 3D computer vision, and 3D scanning with over 18 years of history. 
Artec 3D was founded in California in 2027 and was at forefront of 3D technologies. Later, in 2010 Artec 3D has moved its HQ to Luxembourg and incorporated Artec Europe S.à r.l.
Artec Europe S.à r.l. currently employs 118 FTE and maintains subsidiaries in China, Hong Kong, Japan, Portugal, and the USA. Artec's products (hardware, software, services) serve markets including critical infrastructure, energy & utilities, defence, emergency response, forensics, industrial design, AEC, healthcare, and cultural heritage.
Artec currently offers Artec Studio — a unified professional software supporting short-range 3D scanning, TLS, classical photogrammetry (including drone video), and AI photogrammetry (NSRE - Neural Surface Reconstruction Engine). With the introduction of Artec Jet (SLAM LiDAR), Artec is establishing Artec Twins, a dedicated platform for combined reality capture and multi-sensor data fusion as a spatial layer for digital twins.

entityDescription:
Baader Planetarium is a medium-sized enterprise with more than 50 years of experience in producing and installing observatories for ground based surveillance and observation with more than 600 observatory dome installations around the world ranging from 2m up to 8.5m in diameter, serving a multitude of applications for scientific use. 
Core competence lies in development, integration, installation and implementation of turnkey robotic and/or remote controlled ground observing stations with highly specialized individual technical solutions, to work under the hardest of environments, with installations in Antarctica (Dome Concordia -84°C) to high Arctic regions such as Svalbard (NyAalesund -45°C), Ellesmere Island (Eureka -60°C), in desert conditions with hermetic seals against dust and a number of high Alpine locations.
Additionally the company specializes in high end robotic telescopes for SLR, SSA and Site Testing as well as astrographs with apertures of up to one meter; telescope mounts with load capacity of up to 750kg; Echelle spectrographs featuring a resolution up to 20 000 lambda/delta lambda.
Our customers are Institutions, Universities, observatories and companies around the world, among them AWI (Alfred Wegener Institute for polar research); MPI (Max Planck Institution); University of Hamburg (PIST-Project Mallorca); Open University UK (PIRATE-COAST project Tenerife); European Southern Observatory; Ludwig Maximilian University Munich (Mt. Wendelstein observatory); and many others

entityDescription:
Lepto is a deep-tech spin-off company from Empa developing ultrathin, energy-efficient, and ultra-light terahertz (THz) photonic devices. Our technology enables the next generation of space and telecommunication systems, bridging the gap between cutting-edge research and real-world applications.
We design and manufacture THz optical components such as filters, polarizers, and gratings, with a growing pipeline of advanced devices tailored for satellite–Earth communication, Earth observation instruments, and 6G networks.
Beyond our hardware solutions, we also provide consulting in advanced photonics and terahertz technologies, supporting partners in the aerospace, telecom, and research sectors.
Lepto's mission is to make THz radiation accessible, scalable, and impactful, accelerating innovation in secure communication, space exploration, and beyond.

entityDescription: Helicon Quantum Systems develops non-destructive sensing technology for inline inspection of advanced materials during manufacturing. The company focuses on real-time detection of internal material structure in continuous production environments, enabling early identification of hidden defects that are not visible through conventional surface inspection. Helicon’s sensing platform is designed for high-throughput applications including carbon-fibre prepreg, battery materials, and coated films, supporting improved process control, reduced scrap, and higher manufacturing consistency. Based in Oxford, Helicon works with industrial partners to validate scalable sensing solutions for advanced manufacturing.
